notes: The marginal 'Hebrew pass over' was read and set aside; the printed 'escape' is what is aligned (rule 38).

'Whilst that' is taken as one rendering of עַד, headed on 'Whilst' as the word realizing that subordinator's own lexeme (rule 55); the competing reading marks 'that' added, but a connective morpheme does stand in the clause.
The single 'I' goes to the explicit אָנֹכִי rather than to the verb's inflection, a written pronoun taking it before a verb-supplied one does (rules 17, 20).
